# Safari export acceptance data

Exported from Safari 27 on macOS 27 on 2026-09-20 using File → Export Browsing Data to File. The example.com test page was visited, bookmarked, and added to Reading List through Safari's UI. Only that public test URL is retained here; unrelated personal entries and empty bookmark folders were removed. History metadata, visit timestamp, titles, and Reading List identifier are from the actual export.

Safari 27 exports Bookmarks.html and ReadingList.html separately. Earlier documented exports put Reading List inside Bookmarks.html. The importer identifies the Reading List by `com.apple.ReadingList`, independently of filenames or localized folder labels.
